card.text: Giant planet 26 au from Beta Pictoris, imaged with VLT/ERIS and JWST in 2026.

sources.label: Sutlieff et al. 2026
sources.quote: We report the direct imaging discovery of a third exoplanet in the beta Pictoris system

introduction.text: Beta Pictoris d is a cool giant planet 26 au from its star, found in 2026 after a decade of hide-and-seek. Its orbit takes about a century.

sources.label: Sutlieff et al. 2026
sources.quote: We report the direct imaging discovery of a third exoplanet in the beta Pictoris system

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured; the orbit is circular here.
